name: spotlake
description: Spot Score Database: Spot Placement Score, Interrupt Frequency, Spot Price

paragraphs: SpotLake system is an integrated data archive service that provides spot instance datasets collected from diverse public cloud vendors. The datasets include various information about spot instances like spot availability, spot interruption frequency, and spot price. Researchers and developers can utilize the SpotLake system to make their own system more cost-efficiently.

SpotLake system currently provides the latest and restricted range of spot datasets collected from AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure through a demo page. We believe numerous systems could achieve a huge improvement in cost efficiency by utilizing the SpotLake system.
